narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Adding is fine, but we cannot multiply without number names.
<bookmark mark='copy'/>Multiplying means making the same pile again and again.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Copying a pile needs hands and sticks, not names, so that idea is wrong.

narration: <bookmark mark='small'/>To check, try each action with small piles of sticks you can see at a glance.
<bookmark mark='compare'/>Then count the answer pile in our own numbers, and see that the two agree.

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says adding is fine, but we cannot multiply without number names. Multiplying is one pile made again and again, and copying a pile needs no names.
